'''M'Jinn''' was once the second biggest city in the world during the [[Age of Legends]].

==History==
It was techonolgically advanced, with glittering skyscrapers, and yet not-so-advanced in that it was still lush, too, with greenery and parks. However, this presumably beautiful city was destroyed during either the [[War of Power]] or the [[Breaking of the World]], and nothing save a few scraps of written knowledge remains to this day. The only known scrap gleaned from the destruction was that [[Balthamel|Eval Ramman]], now known as Balthamel, once occupied a high position at an institute of higher learning.

==Mention==
The city was mentioned a few times during Graendal's and Sammael's secret meetings.{{ref/book|6|6}} Balthamel held a position at an institute of higher learning in M'Jinn but the name of the institution is not known.{{ref/book|twotc|Balthamel}}

==Parallels==
Sammael comments how Graendal's mood is as changeable as the weather in M'Jinn.{{ref/book|6|6}} Jordan could have written this as a reference to {{Wiki|Michigan}}, where the weather is known to be sunny at one moment and rainy the next.
